channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia falas de Flávio em audiência nos EUA: ‘claro objetivo eleitoreiro’
item.description: The Lula government criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR hearing in the U.S., accusing him of having electoral motives by suggesting the postponement of a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods. The government stated that Flávio did not oppose the measure, omitted ties to Jair Bolsonaro's administration, and proposed subordinating Pix to U.S. interests, which it labeled as treason against the nation.

item.title: Nikolas diz que renuncia ao mandato se ‘provarem’ envolvimento em vídeo de Michelle contra Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied involvement in producing the video where Michelle Bolsonaro exposed her rift with Flávio Bolsonaro, pledging to resign if his participation is proven. He also rejected claims that he plans to leave the PL after helping elect a right-wing caucus, stating he remains in the party to build a legitimate and honest right-wing bloc. Despite tensions, Nikolas appeared alongside Flávio at a PL event and reiterated his respect for both, avoiding commentary to prevent amplifying the crisis within Bolsonarism.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia fala de Flávio em audiência nos EUA: "Traição à Pátria"
item.description: The Lula government condemned Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR hearing in the U.S., calling his stance 'treason to the Fatherland' for suggesting a delay in the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, while nearly all other participants opposed the measure. The official statement noted he was the only Brazilian attendee not to oppose the taxation, accusing him of having a clear electoral motive by attacking Brazil's digital violence decrees and legitimizing what it calls an unjust investigation against national workers and businesses.

item.title: Crusoé: Nikolas critica Lula por deixar o Brasil de fora das negociações com EUA
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the Lula government for excluding Brazil from tariff negotiations with the United States, stating the country 'was left out of the negotiation table'. He praised Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for participating in a public hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative's Office (USTR), implying the opposition is acting where the government has failed.

item.title: A reação do governo Lula à ida de Flávio em audiência sobre o tarifaço nos EUA
item.description: The Lula government sharply criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for attending a U.S. public hearing on the tariff against Brazilian exports, accusing him of legitimizing unfounded U.S. allegations, omitting his ties to corruption schemes linked to the Bolsonaro administration, and acting against national interests. The Secom statement claims Bolsonaro betrayed the homeland by pressuring a foreign power to sanction his own country, distinguishing legitimate opposition from treason against the nation.

item.title: Governo diz que 'divergir do governo é legítimo', mas que 'convocar uma potência' contra o Brasil é 'traição à pátria'
item.description: The federal government accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of treason for participating in a U.S. hearing on tariffs against Brazilian products and criticizing the Supreme Federal Court and the Lula administration. The Social Communication Secretariat stated that while disagreeing with the government is legitimate, inviting foreign powers to act against Brazil constitutes treason. Bolsonaro said new tariffs would be the 'worst possible timing' and would benefit Lula in an election year.

item.title: Governo Lula responde a ataques de Flávio Bolsonaro na audiência do USTR
item.description: The Lula government, through the Secretariat of Social Communication, repudiated statements made by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during a USTR hearing, calling them unacceptable. The statement was issued in response to the senator’s criticisms of Brazil’s foreign policy.

item.title: Gabriely publica carta aberta a Endrick após eliminação na Copa
item.description: Gabriely Miranda, wife of Endrick, published an open letter following Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, expressing pride in her husband's performance, thanking God for strength during the tournament, and reaffirming her unwavering support despite criticism over a missed chance against Norway.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem 10, e não 11 armas, e pistola já foi apreendida, diz defesa
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told the STF that the Glock 9mm pistol not found by the Army had already been seized by the Federal District Civil Police, reducing the total number of weapons attributed to the former president from 11 to 10, as stated in the decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Desta vez, somos nós contra o resto, diz coordenador de campanha de Lula
item.description: Gilberto Carvalho, a coordinator of Lula's pre-campaign, stated that Lula's potential re-election in 2026 will depend solely on PT support, without alliances from other candidates in a possible runoff, using the phrase 'us against the rest'. He emphasized that victory is essential for the 'survival of democracy' and praised the favorable climate due to opposition mistakes, especially from Flávio Bolsonaro. The event in Brasília with public employees was declared by the PT as legally lawful, held outside working hours and funded by party resources.

item.title: Governo propõe ao agro limitar renegociação de dívidas a produtores com perdas climáticas
item.description: The Lula government proposed to the agribusiness caucus in Congress that the rural debt renegotiation package be limited solely to producers who suffered losses due to climatic events, excluding other categories of default.

item.title: Tarifaço: governo vê interesse eleitoral em fala de Flávio nos EUA
item.description: Lula government officials assess that Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR hearing in the U.S. had electoral motives, highlighting the opportunistic nature of his remarks on the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods. He criticized the federal government, arguing the tax would benefit Lula ahead of the election and claiming tariffs were politically exploited, calling it the 'worst possible time' for implementation.

item.title: Figueiredo critica assessoria de Flávio Bolsonaro por “vacilo”
item.description: Journalist Paulo Figueiredo criticized the press team of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for a supposed 'blunder' in disseminating his participation in a U.S. public hearing on potential 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods. He said the senator's social media video was generic, lacked substance, and was filmed in an inappropriate setting, while the press release was delayed and allegedly written by AI. Figueiredo questioned the competence of the senator's pre-campaign team.

item.title: Senado aprova criação do ‘Pix Pensão’ para facilitar o pagamento de pensão alimentícia
item.description: The Senate approved the creation of 'Pix Pensão', a system enabling automatic bank transfers for child support payments, even for debtors without formal employment. The bill, previously passed by the Chamber of Deputies in September 2025, now awaits President Lula’s sanction and includes provisions to freeze other financial assets of delinquent payers and mandates the National Justice Council to publish anonymized statistics on child support cases for greater transparency.

item.title: Deputada acusa influencer de violência de gênero: "Quer jogar bola também?"
item.description: State deputy Ediane Maria (PSOL-SP) filed a complaint with the Electoral Public Ministry against influencer Henrique Manzione for political gender violence after he posted a video containing sexist insults, such as telling her to 'wash dishes' and 'look at pots' instead of commenting on women's football. The deputy had previously shared a post inviting the public to follow the 2027 Women's World Cup, to be held in Brazil, which triggered the influencer's response. The complaint is based on Article 326-B of the Electoral Code, which criminalizes political violence against women.

item.title: PEC da aposentadoria de agentes de saúde passa por segunda sessão de discussão
item.description: PEC 14/2021, which lowers the retirement age for community health agents and endemic disease control agents from 62/65 to 57/60 years (with 25 years of contributions), passed its second debate session in the first round and requires three more sessions before a vote scheduled for April 15. The proposal, already approved by the Chamber in 2025 and reported in the Senate by Senator Irajá (PSD-TO), also extends to indigenous health and sanitation agents and applies to both RPPS and RGPS regimes.

item.title: Defesa diz que arma ‘perdida’ de Bolsonaro está com a Polícia Civil do DF
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told Minister Alexandre de Moraes that a missing Glock 9mm pistol, one of the ex-president's firearms not in Army custody, was seized by the Federal District Civil Police from the vehicle of a military member of his security team during a blitz in Brasília. The defense claims there was a minor error in the gun's serial number. The other unlocated weapon, a Maestro Arms Company shotgun allegedly gifted to Bolsonaro, is said to remain with the importer in Rio Grande do Sul.

item.title: Nikolas diz que não participou de vídeo de Michelle e reclama de ‘fogo amigo’
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied involvement in the production of videos by former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticizing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he would resign if proven otherwise. He complained of 'friendly fire' within the PL, accusing allies of spreading false narratives against him, and emphasized he has no intention of leaving the party. His office's statement clarified that neither he nor his team participated in any stage of the video's creation.

item.title: Operação da PF fragiliza mais um aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro no RJ
item.description: The Federal Police carried out a search and seizure operation against Márcio Canella, a Senate pre-candidate from União Brasil and ally of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, on suspicion of money laundering. The operation took place on Wednesday, July 7, and has raised doubts about the viability of Canella’s candidacy in Rio de Janeiro. This weakens the political support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign in 2026.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto que endurece penas por violência sexual digital contra crianças e adolescentes
item.description: The Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for digital sexual violence against children and adolescents, including offenses involving AI, deepfakes, and IP masking. The proposal replaces the term 'pornography' with 'sexual violence' to better reflect the gravity of such acts, aligning with international standards like the Budapest Convention, and includes AI-generated material in the definition of heinous crimes.

item.title: Alcolumbre critica “ameaça” de líder do PT sobre PEC da 6 X 1
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre rejected statements by PT Chamber leader Deputy Pedro Uczai, who labeled him an 'enemy' of the labor agenda if he did not forward the 6x1 PEC to the Constitution and Justice Committee. Alcolumbre declared that threats and intimidation will not be tolerated, emphasizing that agenda-setting is a constitutional prerogative of the Senate presidency and that he will not yield to political ultimatums. The 6x1 PEC, a key Lula administration priority, has remained stalled in the Senate since May 28 and is unlikely to be voted on before the parliamentary recess begins July 18.

item.title: Senado aprova PL para tornar partidos passíveis de controle por lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The Senate approved a bill that subjects political parties to anti-money laundering regulations, requiring them to adopt mechanisms to detect suspicious financial transactions and be included in the list of entities obligated to implement such controls. The proposal, authored by Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) and favorably reported by Senator Ivete da Silveira (MDB-SC), aims to hold parties accountable for benefits derived from money laundering and strengthen electoral integrity. If no appeal is filed, the bill will proceed directly to the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que não aceitará ‘ultimatos’ sobre fim da escala 6×1 e sinaliza atraso na matéria
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre rejected pressure from PT Chamber leader Pedro Uczai, stating he will not accept 'ultimatums' regarding the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale. He emphasized that legislative agenda setting is exclusively the Senate Presidency's prerogative and reaffirmed his commitment to dialogue following meetings with government and union representatives. The proposal, approved by the Chamber in May, awaits referral to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), but risks stagnation due to the parliamentary recess starting July 17.

item.title: Janja defende PL da Misoginia e critica grupos “red pill”
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva advocated for the approval of the Misogyny Bill, which has received urgency approval in the Chamber and was previously passed in the Senate, proposing prison sentences of 2 to 5 years for misogynistic acts, including online profile blocking mechanisms and enhanced penalties in domestic violence contexts. She also criticized 'red pill' groups, linking them to hate speech that fuels femicide and described the 'manosphere' as a disinformation strategy targeting youth on social media.

item.title: Governo adia Conselho de Política Externa por restrições eleitorais
item.description: The federal government postponed the creation of the National Council of Brazilian Foreign Policy (Conpeb) due to the electoral blackout period, which restricts public administration actions to ensure equal conditions among candidates. Announced in June by Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol), the council aimed to involve civil society in shaping foreign policy and counter what he described as the 'surrender and betrayal' of Bolsonarists. The launch, originally scheduled for this week, now has no set date.

item.title: PF prende ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo, suspeito de lavagem de R$ 7,6 bi, com fuzil fura blindagem
item.description: The former mayor of Belford Roxo, Márcio Canella (União Brasil), was arrested in flagrante by the Federal Police during Operation Unha e Carne after being found with a .556 caliber rifle in his vehicle. He is under investigation for alleged involvement in a money laundering scheme that moved R$ 7.6 billion through a network of gas stations, along with charges of criminal organization and illegal contracting. Canella, a Senate pre-candidate, resigned as mayor to run in this year’s election, with former councilwoman Rogéria Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) as his first substitute on the ticket.

item.title: Pedido de Damares ao TSE tem Michelle Bolsonaro como pano de fundo
item.description: Senator Damares Alves requested TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to create a task force to combat deep fakes and manipulated online content, with Michelle Bolsonaro serving as background motivation. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: “Lula quer te impedir de saber quanto imposto você vai pagar”
item.description: Federal Deputy Kim Kataguiri accused President Lula of attempting to prevent Brazilians from knowing how much tax they will pay starting in 2027 due to the tax reform, citing statements from Federal Revenue Secretary Robson Barreirinhas. The claim was made in a video posted on X (formerly Twitter) and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: "Nunca!", diz ministro sobre negociar paridade do etanol com EUA
item.description: Minister Márcio Elias Rosa stated that reducing tariffs on ethanol for the United States is not under negotiation, responding 'Never!' to the proposal for tariff parity raised by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. He emphasized that President Lula defends keeping ethanol out of the current trade negotiations with the U.S., warning that opening the market to American ethanol would jeopardize production in the Northeast, a region already suffering from falling prices. The minister added that technical talks between Brazil and the U.S. are ongoing, with another meeting expected by the end of this week or early next week.

item.title: Planalto vê desespero de Flávio Bolsonaro nos EUA para se descolar das tarifas
item.description: The Planalto Palace downplayed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to the United States, viewing it as a desperate attempt to distance himself from the government's tariff policies. Officials assessed that the senator is trying to break free from the economic legacy of former President Jair Bolsonaro, but without apparent success in the eyes of the federal administration.

item.title: Bolsonaro hijo viaja a Washington para intentar evitar un nuevo castigo arancelario que dañe su campaña
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and leading right-wing candidate for the 2026 elections, traveled to Washington to urge the United States not to impose new tariffs on Brazil, fearing such measures could harm his electoral campaign. His visit came after Brazil's elimination from the World Cup, marking the unofficial start of the election race in Latin America's most populous nation. He made the plea during a public hearing organized by the USTR, as reported by Folha de S.Paulo.

item.title: PF prende Márcio Canella após achar fuzil em seu carro
item.description: Marcio Canella, president of the União Brasil party in Rio de Janeiro and a pre-candidate for the Senate, was arrested in flagrante by the Federal Police for illegal possession and carrying of a weapon after a .556 rifle was found in his car during Operation Unha e Carne. The operation, authorized by the STF, investigates an alleged money laundering network through gas stations in the Rio metropolitan area, involving public officials and criminals. Two police officers linked to Canella were also targeted in the operation.

item.title: Múcio discutirá classificação do PCC e CV com auxiliar de Trump
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio Monteiro will meet with U.S. Undersecretary of War Elbridge A. Colby during the Conference of Defense Ministers of the Americas in Peru to discuss the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. The meeting follows a preparatory session with President Lula. The Brazilian government warns that the unilateral designation could be invoked to justify extraterritorial U.S. actions, including military force, targeting Brazilian institutions in financial, migration, and penal sectors.

item.title: Governo vê tom 'político-eleitoral' em manifestação de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre tarifaço e diz que ele frustrou empresários
item.description: The Lula government assessed that Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in the U.S. tariff hearing was conducted in a 'purely political-electoral' tone, frustrating Brazilian business leaders who expected a defense of national interests. Presidential aides said the senator focused on attacking the Lula government and the STF, omitting his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro and using the Banco Master case for personal gain.

item.title: Comissão aprova nova regra sobre indenização por dano moral a vítima de violência doméstica
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) of the Chamber of Deputies approved a proposal establishing the right to moral damage compensation in cases of domestic and family violence against women, upon explicit request by the prosecution or the injured party. Compensation will be set by the judge, including in the criminal sphere. Rapporteur Deputy Lídice da Mata (PSB-BA) recommended approval of the substitute bill to PL 1299/22, aiming to strengthen fundamental rights protection and ensure civil reparations for victims.

item.title: Aécio Neves reavalia planos para 2026 e deixa aliados em compasso de espera
item.description: Senator Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG) has reassessed his 2026 plans and told allies he will not run for president, opting instead to pursue a Senate seat in Minas Gerais. Despite being promoted as a presidential alternative by PSDB and Cidadania leaders, he cited low electoral viability — around 2% in polls and high rejection rates — as the reason for stepping back. Allies expect a concrete decision this week, while the party considers releasing its members to support another candidate if it does not field its own presidential nominee.

item.title: Europa Filmes inicia processo de registro de “Dark Horse” na Ancine
item.description: On June 22, 2026, Europa Filmes submitted a Request for Foreign Work Registration (ROE) to Brazil's Ancine for the film 'Dark Horse,' which depicts the life of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The ROE is the first step toward obtaining the Title Registration Certificate (CRT), required for age rating classification by the Ministry of Justice and subsequent theatrical release in Brazil. Ancine confirmed receipt of the request but declined to comment on the merits or provide timelines for further processing.

item.title: STF deve manter investigação que mira suposta relação de amiga de Lulinha com fraudes no INSS mesmo após pedido de arquivamento
item.description: The STF is likely to reject the request to dismiss the investigation against Roberta Moreira Luchsinger, as the Federal Police maintains that investigative diligences are pending and the inquiry remains in the evidence-gathering phase. Her defense claims she was targeted only due to her friendship with Lulinha, but early case dismissal is considered unlikely without clear absence of just cause. The PF has also requested six more months to finalize analysis of seized material from Operation Sem Desconto.

item.title: A reação de integrantes do USTR ao discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o tarifaço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's speech at the USTR hearing was seen as off-topic for prioritizing political themes over technical arguments, causing discomfort among U.S. trade representatives. According to FGV professor Gustavo Pessoa, the senator focused on presidential elections, corruption, and STF conflicts instead of trade tariffs, and was listened to mainly due to his alliance with Donald Trump. The only technical point mentioned, Pix, was also politicized.

item.title: Deputado estadual acusa Dino de coagir parlamentares no MA
item.description: State deputy Yglésio Moyses (PRD-MA) accused Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino of leveraging his position to pressure and blackmail legislators in Maranhão to support the pre-candidacy of Eduardo Braide (PSD) for governor. The claims were made during a speech in the Maranhão Legislative Assembly, with no concrete evidence presented so far.

item.title: Ajustes de última hora, Eduardo na plateia e bronca por fotos: os bastidores da audiência de Flávio nos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro awaited the start of a public hearing at the USTR in Washington alongside his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, after attempts to record images were halted by organizers. His team made last-minute adjustments to the speech to emphasize the cancellation — not just delay — of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, defend Pix, and advocate for bilateral negotiation over trade barriers, aiming to prevent the perception that the move was timed to avoid electoral consequences in 2026. Internal assessments viewed these minutes as pivotal to reversing the negative narrative stemming from an earlier 86-page document, which opponents had framed as a delaying tactic.

item.title: Ex-prefeito Márcio Canella é preso pela PF após apreensão de fuzil em seu carro
item.description: The former mayor of Belford Roxo and União Brasil Senate pré-candidate, Márcio Canella, was arrested by the Federal Police after a 5.56mm rifle was found in his car during the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne. He is accused of being the political arm of a criminal organization suspected of laundering over R$7.6 billion through a network of gas stations in the Rio de Janeiro metropolitan area. The operation also targets former officials and police officers, with search warrants, asset seizures, and suspensions of economic activities linked to the group.

item.title: Te encontro em Sampa de onde agora se vê quem sobe ou desce a rampa
item.description: The text reflects on Brazilian cultural production in the early 1990s as an expression of post-dictatorship disillusionment, highlighting works like the film Terra estrangeira and songs by Jorge Ben Jor and Caetano Veloso that used the metaphor of the Planalto Palace ramp to criticize the disconnect between power and the people. It draws a parallel between the pessimism of that era and São Paulo’s ongoing role as a center of political protest, from demonstrations against Dilma Rousseff and Temer to the present, suggesting that while the symbolic distance between the ramp and the city has narrowed, the tension between power and society persists.

item.title: Nos EUA, Flávio Bolsonaro cita caso Master sem mencionar Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro cited the Banco Master investigation during a USTR hearing to link financial fraud to the Lula government, but omitted that he had sought funding from the bank's owner for the 'Dark Horse' biopic. He also defended Pix as beneficial to U.S. companies and called the timing of potential U.S. tariffs 'the worst possible,' arguing it would reward those responsible for the alleged misconduct.

item.title: Senado inclui partidos no rol de controle contra lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The Senate's Public Security Committee approved a bill to include political parties in the anti-money laundering control framework. The proposal requires parties to maintain transaction records, notify the Coaf of suspicious operations to the Financial Activities Control Council (Coaf), and implement internal control mechanisms, and face fines of up to R$20 million for non-compliance. The bill now moves to the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Trevisan: Flávio culpar Lula por tarifas é 'fala enganosa' até para Trump
item.description: Professor Leonardo Trevisan states that blaming President Lula for the tariffs imposed by the U.S. on Brazil is a misleading claim, even under Donald Trump's logic. He argues the assertion does not hold up technically or politically, as U.S. tariffs are unilaterally decided by the American government.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio vai para Washington enquanto Lula não tem pressa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, will participate this Tuesday, February 7, in a public hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR), accompanied by his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro. While Flávio travels to Washington, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shows no urgency in responding or taking a stance on the matter. The Bolsonaro brothers’ move suggests an international projection strategy aimed at strengthening their electoral base ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Zema culpa Lula por tarifaço e diz esperar solução 'independentemente de quem vier'
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) blamed the foreign policy of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government for the U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, but said he expects a solution regardless of who resolves the issue.

item.title: Moraes autoriza PF a ouvir Flávio Bolsonaro por acusação de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the Federal Police to hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged slander against President Lula, based on a January social media post linking Lula to Nicolás Maduro and accusing him of drug trafficking, money laundering, and election fraud. The hearing must occur within 10 days following a PGR request, which noted the potential for Bolsonaro to retract his statements and avoid punishment. Both are pre-candidates in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Como El Niño pode mexer com a eleição presidencial no Brasil
item.description: The El Niño phenomenon, expected to intensify in 2026, could significantly impact Brazil’s presidential elections by worsening droughts, raising food prices, and increasing wildfire risks in the Amazon. Although the government has issued alerts and prepared preventive measures, experts warn that bank financing for deforestation-linked commodity chains — totaling $429 billion between 2016 and 2025 — could undermine these efforts, making forests more flammable. Environmental and social movements from Brazil, Malaysia, and Indonesia are urging banks to halt funding for destructive activities and redirect credit toward sustainable practices like agroecology and agroforestry.
